## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Raw signed Rxx(B) first, then the deg-5 B-space detrend vs 1/B, FFT (B ≥ 1.5 T) and the `sdh_onset` tone table. **Read:** SdH is strong on both sides and survives to low field — the oscillatory content starts at ≤ 0.7 T (hole) and a ~7 T tone on the electron side persists to the record edge (0.3 T), so T_e ≈ 8 K does not kill the fan. **Electron (run 6, F_L = 33.1 T):** a low tone at **7.1 T** plus high-F content at **22–30 T**; `sdh_onset` flags the high tones as ~3×/4× of 7.1, but the 7.1 + ~26 T pair also matches an ABAB-like two-band split (model ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T). A 1D record cannot tell a harmonic from an independent band — that is exactly what the fan's F(n) tracks do (harmonics stay locked at k·F₁; an independent band tracks the sum rule F₁ + F₂ = F_L(n)). Rxx dips **negative** (to −33 Ω, 6 % of points, phase flipping ±180°) near 2–3 T and 6 T: Hall admixture from the inhomogeneous current path (region-B mosaic, run 5) — the one-pair Rxx is not a clean Rxx at QH minima. **Hole (run 7, F_L = 12.4 T):** the strongest tone is **12.3 T ≈ F_L** (SNR 124), with 4.7 / 6.6 / 8.5 T companions. **Take:** the frequency content is rich but ambiguous at single densities — this is not a stacking read yet; it sets the fan: B_lo ≈ 0.6 T, Nyquist ≥ 40 T in 1/B above 1.25 T, n over the full D = 0 line.

# Runs 6-7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (run-5 calibration): electron n = +3.2e12 (B 0->10 T), hole n = -1.2e12 (B 10->0.3 T).
# Raw first (signed Rxx and sr1 phase vs B), then B-space deg-5 detrend vs 1/B, FFT (B >= 1.5 T), sdh_onset tone table.
import warnings
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(13, 11))
for j, (rid, n12) in enumerate([(6, +3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); o = np.argsort(B); B = B[o]
    R = ((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain))[o]; P = r.col("sr1_P")[o]
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0; F_L = {FL:.1f} T; B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, {r.rows} pts; "
          f"signed R {R.min():+.1f}..{R.max():+.1f} Ohm ({100*np.mean(R<0):.0f} % of pts < 0); T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=.8); ax[0, j].axhline(0, color="k", lw=.5)
    ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("signed Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)"); ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    a2 = ax[0, j].twinx(); a2.plot(B, P, "r-", lw=.4, alpha=.5); a2.set_ylabel("sr1 phase (deg)", color="r")
    m = B > 1.0; d = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], d, lw=.7); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("ΔRxx (Ohm)"); ax[1, j].set_title("detrended (deg-5 in B, B > 1 T)")
    m = B >= 1.5
    f, sp = sdh_fft(R[m][:, None], B[m], log=False, bg_degree=5, nfft=4096); sp = sp[0]
    ax[2, j].plot(f, sp / sp[(f > 2) & (f < 60)].max(), ".-", ms=3); ax[2, j].axvline(FL, color="k", ls=":", label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    ax[2, j].set_xlim(0, 60); ax[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2, j].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm)"); ax[2, j].legend(); ax[2, j].set_title("FFT in 1/B, B ≥ 1.5 T (res ≈ 1.8 T)")
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
    print(on.summary()); [print("   warn:", x.message) for x in w]
fig.suptitle("vti-02 runs 6-7: SdH spot checks at D = 0 (region-A calibration, run 5)"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking discriminator

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: B 0.6->10 T ascending, 138 rows (1/B-uniform dx 0.03 / 0.0125 below 2.8 T, 0.1 T above) x n -1.25->+3.20e12 along D=0, 90 pts co-swept Vtg/Vbg, fast\_delay 1 s, sr1 100 uV, Vsi 0; ends at 10 T, gates parked · **ETA ~11:26** (≈6h)

Plan step 4 (`hera_scratch/plan.md`), operator's request. Runs 6–7 (ana cell 15) show strong SdH from ≤ 0.7 T on both sides, but at single densities the content is ambiguous: electron n = +3.2×10¹² has 7.1 T plus 22–30 T, which is either one surface's harmonics or a two-band (ABAB-like, model 7.5 / 25.6 T) split; hole n = −1.2×10¹² is dominated by 12.3 T ≈ F_L. The fan settles it: per-n FFT in 1/B gives **F_i(n) tracks** (harmonics stay locked at k·F₁; independent bands obey F₁ + F₂ = F_L(n) with a drifting ratio; ABCA is one track at F_L), the (n, B) map shows whether there are **LL crossings** between two families, and the fan's LL slopes calibrate the density scale (the c_tg 9.5 nm prior is unverified, and the sum rule needs it). Region B (the parallel ridge, electron-doped by 0.43×10¹²) should show as a second fan origin at n_A ≈ −0.43×10¹².

**Geometry.** Fast: n −1.25 → +3.20×10¹² along D = 0 (run-5 calibration), 0.05×10¹² steps, 90 pts, Vtg/Vbg co-swept (`multimegasweep`), every point inside the validators (asserted). Slow: B 0.6 → 10 T ascending from where the magnet sits — uniform in 1/B below 2.8 T (Δ(1/B) 0.03 to 1.25 T, where only the light tones live; 0.0125 to 2.76 T, Nyquist 40 T > F_L,max 33 T), then 0.1 T steps; 138 rows. Ends at 10 T so step 5 (finite-D fan) rides it down. **Coverage trade:** the n window is the full D = 0 line inside the TG limits (−1.28 … +3.26), so the hole side stops at −1.25×10¹²; +B only — the Hall admixture seen as negative Rxx in run 6 is not symmetrized away (a −B fan would double the cost; revisit only if the admixture swamps the columns). The 0.05×10¹² step undersamples the LL period in n below ~1.5 T (0.097×10¹²/T); the per-column FFT in 1/B is unaffected. **Settings:** `sr1` fixed at 100 µV (10 kΩ FS at 10 nA; runs 6–7 peaked at 590 Ω, a CNP stripe may rail at high B — accepted); fast_delay 1.0 s = 3.3 τ (τ 0.3 s / 24 dB): the ~1-point lock-in lag is the same in every row (same sweep direction), so it shifts features uniformly by ≲ 0.05×10¹², not per-row. Leak guard aborts on 2 consecutive points with |I_gate| > 1 nA; gates park at 0 on completion or abort, field stays put.

**Price** (calibrated on run 5: 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0, +0.05 s for the second gate): row = 90 × 1.15 s + slow_delay 3 s + flyback ~3.6 s + field settle 3.1 s ≈ 113 s; 138 rows ≈ 4.3 h, + 9.4 T of ramp at 0.137 T/min ≈ 69 min, + 0 → 0.6 T ≈ 5 min → **≈ 5.5 h floor, ~6 h realistic**. **Checkpoints:** first rows (0.6 T): current ≈ 9.9 nA, R along the row matches run 5's D = 0 cut (≈ 50–500 Ω, CNP peak near n = 0 and a second near −0.43), gate currents at the pA offsets, no rail. Then ~every 1.5 h: at B ≈ 1.3 T (end of the coarse-1/B segment) and B ≈ 2.8 T (end of the FFT-dense segment) a partial per-column FFT on the landed rows (are there tracks, how many), and at ~6 T the fan picture (crossings, rail extent). Abandon if the channel rails over > 15 % of a row below 5 T or the columns show no oscillation content by 2.8 T.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 0.6 -> 10 T ascending x n fast -1.25 -> +3.20e12 along D = 0 (co-swept Vtg/Vbg) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, c_tg = 9.5 nm geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D_FAN = 0.0                                            # V/nm
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.25, 3.2001, 0.05), 4)   # 1e12 cm^-2, 90 pts (D = 0 line reaches -1.28 .. +3.26 inside the validators)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.full_like(n_vec, D_FAN), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.round(Vtg_vec, 5), np.round(Vbg_vec, 5)
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, "fast vector outside validators"
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_n_chk, n_vec, atol=1e-3) and np.allclose(_D_chk, D_FAN, atol=1e-4)
print(f"fast: {len(n_vec)} pts n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 at D = {D_FAN}; Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V")

# --- slow: field, ascending from where the magnet sits (0 T). Uniform in 1/B at low B (FFT-ready), uniform in B above:
#     0.6 -> 1.25 T at d(1/B) = 0.03 (Nyquist 16.7 T; only light tones alive there), 1.25 -> 2.76 T at d(1/B) = 0.0125
#     (Nyquist 40 T > F_L max 33 T), 2.8 -> 10 T at 0.1 T.
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((1 / np.arange(1 / 0.6, 0.8 - 1e-9, -0.03),
                                      1 / np.arange(0.8, 0.35355 - 1e-9, -0.0125),
                                      np.arange(2.8, 10.0 + 1e-9, 0.1))), 4))
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"slow: {len(B_vec)} rows B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; max d(1/B) {np.max(-np.diff(1/B_vec)):.4f}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
_pre = dict(T_sample=_T0, B=_B0, V_si=k_si(), nplci=(k_tg.nplci(), k_bg.nplci()), PS=magnet.persistent_switch_on(),
            out=magnet.output_enabled(), heater_ranges=(int(heater.sample_range()), int(heater.vaporizer_range())),
            drive=(sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()), sr1_tau=(sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()), sr0_sens=sr0.sensitivity())
print("precondition expected: T 1.0-1.5 K, |B| < 0.05 T, V_si 0, nplci (1,1), PS on, output on, heaters (0,0), drive (1.0 V, 13.777 Hz), "
      "sr1 tau (0.3 s, 24 dB), sr0 sens 0.02")
print("precondition actual:  ", _pre)
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at 0: {_B0}"
assert abs(_pre["V_si"]) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert _pre["nplci"] == (1, 1), "gate-current nplci not 1"
assert _pre["PS"] and _pre["out"], "magnet PS heater / output"
assert _pre["heater_ranges"] == (0, 0), "a heater range is on"
assert abs(_pre["drive"][0] - 1.0) < 1e-3 and abs(_pre["drive"][1] - 13.777) < 0.01, "drive not 1.0 V / 13.777 Hz (I_bias 10 nA)"
assert _pre["sr1_tau"] == (0.3, 24), "sr1 tau/slope changed — fast_delay is priced on 0.3 s / 24 dB"
assert abs(_pre["sr0_sens"] - 0.02) < 1e-9, "sr0 sensitivity not 20 mV (20 nA FS)"

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (state0 restore left sr1 at 2 uV): 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA.
# Runs 6-7 peaked at 590 Ohm at 10 T; the CNP stripe at high B may rail — accepted (not needed for F(n)).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 3.0
I_TRIP, N_TRIP = 1e-9, 2          # A; consecutive points over threshold before abort (single flyback glitch is not a leak)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0: B slow {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows, 1/B-uniform below 2.8 T), "
                  f"n fast {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts, 0.05e12) along D = 0, Vsi 0, sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D_FAN} V/nm (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}); '
              f'n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 step 0.05 (co-swept Vtg/Vbg); B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ascending, '
              f'd(1/B) 0.03 to 1.25 T, 0.0125 to 2.76 T, then 0.1 T; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s; plan step 4')

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
s.ramp(magnet.field, B_vec[0])        # 0 -> 0.6 T, blocking ~4.5 min
print(f"at start: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, Vtg {k_tg.volt():+.4f}, Vbg {k_bg.volt():+.4f}")
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, magnet.field, sr1.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)

_over = {"n": 0}
def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    _over["n"] = _over["n"] + 1 if (i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP) else 0
    if _over["n"] >= N_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A ({N_TRIP} consecutive)")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # gates park at 0 (safe unattended end / abort); field stays where the fan left it (10 T at completion) —
    # the next step (finite-D fan) rides it down, never re-traversing.
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, Vtg {k_tg.volt():+.4f}, Vbg {k_bg.volt():+.4f}, T_sample {T_sample():.3f} K")

The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
